profile.summary: Aspire Public Schools is a nonprofit that runs a network of public charter schools in California. It describes its mission as preparing underserved students for college, training highly effective teachers and sharing innovative best practices. Aspire Golden State College Preparatory Academy is one of its Oakland schools.
